---
title: "NYC Resturants (For P8105 HW Assignment)"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: columns
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(patchwork)
library(plotly)

data("rest_inspec")

rest_inspec = rest_inspec |> 
  rename(borough = boro) |> 
  filter(borough != "0", grade %in% c("A","B","C")) |> 
  mutate(dba = str_to_lower(dba),
         street = str_to_lower(street)) 

```

## Column {width="65%"}

```{r}
#| title: "NYC Resturant Locations By Inspection Scores"
rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude),
    latitude != 0,
    longitude != 0
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c(
      "Borough: ", borough,
      "\nCuisine: ", cuisine_description,
      "\nInspection Score: ", score,
      "\nGrade: ", grade
    )
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~longitude,
    y = ~latitude,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    color = ~score,
    text = ~text_label,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) 
```

## Column {width="35%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Number of Restaurant Inspections by Borough"

rest_inspec |> 
  count(borough) |> 
  mutate(borough = fct_reorder(borough, n)) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~borough, y = ~n, type = "bar", 
          color = ~borough, colors = "viridis")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Inspection Scores by Borough"

rest_inspec |> 
  mutate(borough = fct_reorder(borough, score)) |> 
  plot_ly(y = ~score, color = ~borough, 
          type = "box", colors = "viridis")
```
